title: 3的倍数
problem_statement_md:
给定的程序，输出0到20的所有数字。

请修改代码，使其只输出为3倍数的数字。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]while loop[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You are given a program that outputs all the numbers from 0 to 20.
Change the code to make it output only numbers that are [b]multiples of 3[/b].

[note]Be attentive and don't output 0.[/note]
